interactions.sentence: [color=#ffffff][b]Binh:[/b][/color] One [b]coffee sachet[/b], please. The red strip above you. Another early shift.

response_choices: Still working on the house repairs?

interactions.sentence: [color=#ffffff][b]Binh:[/b][/color] Hanh says I still owe a million. I paid her last Friday. She kept the receipt to update her book.

response_choices: Ask her to write you another receipt.

interactions.sentence: [color=#ffffff][b]Binh:[/b][/color] Just charge me for the coffee today. I am going back for that receipt.
[color=#ffffff][b]Binh:[/b][/color] You see everyone who comes through this alley. If she asks, remember I was here.
